raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Bodyweight Strength Program (no equipment except doorway pull-up bar)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build foundational upper and lower body strength using bodyweight progressions and doorway pull-up bar support"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation Push & Pull 1":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up 3x3..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bodyweight_row_under_doorframe 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 seconds rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Foundation Lower 1":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          forward_step_no_gap 3x10..12 per leg rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20 seconds per side rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Foundation Push & Pull 2":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up_assisted 3x3..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          doorframe_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20 seconds rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation Push & Pull 3":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up_assisted 4x3..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bodyweight_row_under_doorframe 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 4x30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Foundation Lower 2":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lunge_step_through 4x8..12 per leg rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x25 seconds per side
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Foundation Pull Bonus":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up_assisted 4x3..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          doorframe_row 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 per side rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression Push & Pull A":
        warmup:
          mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up 4x4..7 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          incline_push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          doorframe_row 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Progression Lower A":
        warmup:
          mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..16 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 4x10 per leg rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 4x35 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_stretches 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 50m "Progression Pull/Core":
        warmup:
          mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up_assisted 4x4..7 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row_bodyweight 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 4x10 per side
          hollow_hold 3x25 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression Push & Pull B":
        warmup:
          jog 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x10..14 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up_assisted 4x5..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          decline_push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          doorframe_row 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Progression Lower B":
        warmup:
          jog 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x10..14 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          single_leg_balance_to_squat 3x6..8 per leg rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..16 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30 seconds per side
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 50m "Core & Pull Focus":
        warmup:
          jog 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up_assisted 4x5..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row_bodyweight 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 4x12 per side
          bicycle_crunch 3x20 per side
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Phase 3 Push & Pull":
        warmup:
          dynamic_mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x12..16 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up 4x5..9 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          doorframe_row 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Phase 3 Lower & Core":
        warmup:
          dynamic_mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x12..16 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x15..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8..12 per leg rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 4x40 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_stretches 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 55m "Phase 3 Pull & Core":
        warmup:
          dynamic_mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up_assisted 4x6..9 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row_bodyweight 4x10..14 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 4x30 seconds
          mountain_climber 3x30 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Phase 3 Push/Pull Intensity":
        warmup:
          mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x12..18 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up_assisted 4x6..9 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          doorframe_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Phase 3 Lower Power":
        warmup:
          mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x12..16 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          single_leg_bridge 4x10 per leg rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 4x12 per leg rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 4x30 seconds per side
        cooldown:
          hip_stretches 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 55m "Phase 3 Core & Pull High Rep":
        warmup:
          mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up_assisted 4x6..9 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row_bodyweight 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          russian_twist 3x20 per side
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 4 Max Strength Prep":
        warmup:
          mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x12..16 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 5x6..9 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          doorframe_row 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Phase 4 Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x10..14 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 5x12..16 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          reverse_lunge 4x8..12 per leg rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          plank 4x45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_stretches 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Phase 4 Pull & Core":
        warmup:
          mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up 5x6..9 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row_bodyweight 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 4x40 seconds
          mountain_climber 4x40 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: `3x8..12`. Wrong: `3x8-12`.
- Sets always come first: `3x10` means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: `3x8..12 rpe 7`.
- Rest in seconds: `rest 90 seconds`.

EXERCISE VOCABULARY (use ONLY these canonical names):
push_up, pull_up, chin_up, dip, bench_press, incline_press, decline_press, dumbbell_press, shoulder_press, overhead_press, military_press, arnold_press, dumbbell_row, barbell_row, bent_over_row, cable_row, seated_row, lat_pulldown, cable_pulldown, bicep_curl, hammer_curl, concentration_curl, preacher_curl, tricep_dip, tricep_extension, tricep_pushdown, skull_crusher, face_pull, rear_delt_fly, lateral_raise, front_raise, dumbbell_fly, cable_fly, chest_fly, pec_deck, shrug, upright_row, squat, front_squat, goblet_squat, sumo_squat, split_squat, lunge, walking_lunge, reverse_lunge, lateral_lunge, deadlift, romanian_deadlift, sumo_deadlift, trap_bar_deadlift, leg_press, hack_squat, leg_curl, leg_extension, calf_raise, seated_calf_raise, standing_calf_raise, glute_bridge, hip_thrust, step_up, box_jump, jump_squat, hip_abduction, hip_adduction, good_morning, plank, side_plank, plank_up, crunch, bicycle_crunch, reverse_crunch, sit_up, v_up, russian_twist, wood_chop, leg_raise, hanging_leg_raise, lying_leg_raise, mountain_climber, dead_bug, bird_dog, ab_wheel, ab_rollout, hollow_hold, hollow_rock, toe_touch, pallof_press, superman, back_extension, jumping_jack, jump_rope, high_knees, butt_kicks, burpee, squat_jump, tuck_jump, arm_circles, leg_swings, hip_circles, ankle_circles, jog_in_place, marching, jumping_lunge, box_step, skater_jump, bear_crawl, crab_walk, inchworm, hamstring_stretch, quad_stretch, hip_flexor_stretch, calf_stretch, achilles_stretch, chest_stretch, shoulder_stretch, tricep_stretch, lat_stretch, back_stretch, spinal_twist, neck_stretch, neck_roll, butterfly_stretch, frog_stretch, pigeon_pose, child_pose, cat_cow, forward_fold, standing_forward_fold, figure_four_stretch, wrist_circles, ankle_rolls, turkish_getup, clean, clean_and_press, snatch, kettlebell_swing, thrusters, wall_ball, farmers_walk, suitcase_carry, battle_ropes, rowing

CARDIO MODALITIES (use ONLY these names for warmups, cooldowns, and cardio sessions):
running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking

Note: This plan emphasizes progressive overload via increased reps, sets, and reduced assists, while leveraging the doorway pull-up bar and bodyweight movements. Adjust difficulty by altering leverage (e.g., feet elevated, incline/pull-up assistance) and tempo if needed. Ensure proper rest, nutrition, and sleep support.
